name: wilson
description: WILSON - AI-powered creative production & learning platform
author: Petal Studios
_comment:build: Session 40, and it lives at the ROOT rather than inside `build` ON PURPOSE: electron-builder validates the `build` object against a JSON schema and REJECTS unknown properties, so a `_comment:` key in there fails `npm run dist` outright. 🚨 `build` IS THE ONE PACKAGER (F12, 2026-11-18: Electron Forge, forge.config.cjs and the Squirrel guard are gone). `npm run dist` makes the nsis installer users receive; `npm run package` is the same config left unpacked (electron-builder --dir: release/win-unpacked/, no installer and no app-update.yml, so that build cannot update itself). extraResources copies OUTSIDE the asar by construction, which is what an executable needs: a binary inside an archive cannot be exec'd. Look in release/win-unpacked/resources/ffmpeg/ after either. resources/ffmpeg/ is committed (README + .gitignore) so the glob always resolves; the binary itself is gitignored because the repo is PUBLIC, so a checkout without it builds with no resources/ffmpeg/ folder at all.

scripts._comment:test:lock: Bundle B3 — the desktop loopback lock over a real socket (401 without the per-launch token, 200 with header or cookie), plus a control that must fail. Pass --show-control to watch it go red.
scripts._comment:build:rules: F9: writes electron/rules/ — the desktop's CommonJS copies of the renderer's rule modules, bundled from them by esbuild. Run it after changing a rule module; the files are committed, and src/lib/electronRules.test.js fails while they are stale.
scripts._comment:dev:admin: Serves BOTH entries. Open /admin.html for the operator console — / still serves the product app, but built with __WILSON_SURFACE__='admin', so its session key is the operator one. Do not sign in at / under this mode.
scripts._comment:package: F12: the SAME `build` config as `dist`, left unpacked in release/win-unpacked/ (no installer). 🚨 Never START what either makes to test it: a packaged WILSON opens the real data folder of whoever starts it (WILSON_USER_DATA is honoured only unpackaged). Read the build's file list instead.
